records.name: Libertas
records.evidence_locations: Salys PDF310/printed295, 14 July 1964 calendar list; original page image inspected in round 108.
records.facts_used: The Lithuanian historical name calendar pairs Libertas with the proposed short form Libas. This documents a naming recommendation without assigning a single distant word origin to the name. The 1964 calendar, reprinted in Antanas Salys’s collected writings in 1983, places Libertas on 14 July. The recommendation is evidence of calendar history, not the first bearer or the invention of the name.
